items.title: Hims & Hers Rises 4% as Eli Lilly Deal Brings Zepbound to Its Platform: “A Clear Positive”

items.title: Lilly to sell obesity drugs directly on Hims & Hers site
items.summary: Nov 6 (Reuters) - Eli Lilly said on Friday it struck a deal to allow Hims & Hers Health to sell obesity drugs Zepbound and Foundayo directly ‌on its platform, sending the telehealth company's shares up more than 7% in premarket ‌trading. The Lilly drugs were previously available to patients on Hims & Hers only if they left the site and went to ​Lilly's own cash-pay platform LillyDirect.
